I try not to buy into 'hot' and 'cold' teams. I also try not to get 'feelings' a team is going to upset another.

First check: are the teams evenly matched in my eyes? If not, I pick the team I think is clearly better (pretty simple I know)

If they are not evenly matched, who are the QBs? Do I trust one QB to win games where I doubt the other QB. I will pick the QB I trust is clearly better

So the teams seem evenly matched, the QBs seem evenly matched or at least closely matched, what do? Pick the home team.

If the teams are both really bad? Home team.

Home team picking is always my safety net if I am unsure on what to do, which is what I should have done with the Falcons-Eagles, but you win some you lose some.
